discoveries:
- Three record commits had made the head red at `21302ae9`. W1-08's red refused W2-02's close at 15:36 after 75.6 minutes, as the report predicted; DEC-885 repaired the cause, and the queue's new gate (f) now runs the record-reading test files before each close.
- DEC-883's same-code reuse leaves `governance/project/orchestration/` out of its fingerprint. Two of today's three reds came from commits that touched only that folder (finding 18, fails open).
- A selection passed as a list of suite folders breaks W1-35's collection (finding 17).
- W1-25's per-test copy races git's gc, like W1-07's.
- The ratchet's rule that every entry names its fix has no test (finding 19).
- `gov retrieve` still serves superseded DEC-875 and DEC-876 under the id DEC-882. This confirms lens B's F4.

risks:
- DEC-883 item 3, as worded, would let a close reuse a passing run on a head that record commits made red.
- If W2-66 passes its selection as suite folders, every close that selects W1-35 plus another suite will be refused.
- The declared map's safety is unmeasured for the three widest-reaching modules.
- Until a nightly run exists, record-made reds are caught only before a close (gate f), not when they are committed.

lessons:
- A selection trial here must run in the full run's form and filter edit- or tree-sensitive tests with control runs.
- Copy races can fake kills, so keep each failure's message.
- Under a shared close queue, order the trials so the most decision-relevant items run first.

proposed_decisions:
- P-H-2 and P-H-9 (P1): W2-66's card before its test designer starts.
  - P-H-2 covers shared test helpers, serial scoping, the change set's base, the evidence record and the full-run form of the selection.
  - P-H-9 refines DEC-883: the record-reading set runs on every head, the index uses two fingerprints, the serial-only kinds are split, and failing tests re-run alone before any bisect. The DEC-105 recommendation is option (a), apply now.
- P-H-3: start the nightly run now as glue.
- P-H-1: run the record-reading tests after record commits, with a wider set.
- P-H-4: run the lead's verification in the close's form.
- P-H-5: test hygiene, as a new ticket W2-67.
- P-H-6: placement of the test-orchestration capability.
- P-H-7: make the SubagentStop hook show its reason.
- P-H-8: record corrections, plus the ratchet field-rule test in W2-19.
